description: MakerWorld model specs for all 13 active 3D printed Etsy listings. Primary designers: animuL67 (koozies) and HpInvent (home decor). Coffee sign by tpubcom.

animuL67.specialty: Can koozies — Cooler-style holders and sports/novelty variants. New Product Development Engineer, 20+ yrs experience. All models tested on unmodified printers.
animuL67.patreon: No-logo versions on Patreon ($5/mo). Free versions include designer logo on base.

HpInvent.specialty: Home decor — lamps, vases, planters, organizers, candle holders. Mechanical Engineer. 9 featured models on MakerWorld. Commercial licenses via Patreon.
HpInvent.patreon: Commercial licenses and exclusive models available via Patreon.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Desk Pen Holder | Modern Desktop Organizer
products.creator: HpInvent
products.recommended_filament: PLA+ or Silk PLA for premium desk look
products.p1s_notes: Tiered design with removable round inserts — print inserts separately and mix heights. Silk PLA gives premium desk accessory look. Inserts can double as small planters.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Regular Can Koozie | 12oz Standard Can Cooler Sleeve
products.creator: animuL67
products.makerworld_model: Cooler Can Holder (std 12oz can) — No Logo
products.recommended_filament: PLA (standard); Silk PLA for premium sheen; TPU for flexibility
products.p1s_notes: Batch 4 units per plate (88mm footprint fits on 256mm bed). Scale ±0.5% if fit is too snug. Cooler-jug aesthetic with built-in handle and removable lid. Free version has designer logo on base; no-logo version on Patreon.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Skinny Can Koozie | 12oz Slim Can Cooler Sleeve
products.creator: animuL67
products.can_compatibility: Slim/sleek 12oz cans — Red Bull, White Claw, Truly, Michelob Ultra (57mm body diameter)
products.recommended_filament: PLA (standard); Silk PLA; TPU 95A for grip + flexibility
products.p1s_notes: Adapted from the popular std 12oz design for slim cans. Same cooler-jug aesthetic, built-in handle, removable lid with straw hole, rotatable lid. TPU: slow outer wall to 25mm/s, reduce retraction to 0.5mm.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Planter Pot | Modern Indoor Plant Pot
products.creator: HpInvent
products.makerworld_model: Inflated Plant Pot Nr.6 Round Version
products.recommended_filament: PETG (moisture resistant for real soil/water); Silk PLA for display/faux plant
products.p1s_notes: Part of HpInvent's Inflated Cloth series — soft quilted/inflated fabric aesthetic. PETG required if holding soil and water. Silk PLA for dry faux-plant arrangements looks premium in photos. Pairs with Inflated Cloth candle holder for matching set listings.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Tea Light Holder Set of 2 | Boho Candle Holder
products.creator: HpInvent
products.recommended_filament: Translucent PLA or white PLA for warm light diffusion; Silk PLA for display
products.p1s_notes: Designed to match the Inflated Cloth Planter series — sell as a matching set for upsell opportunity. Translucent or white PLA diffuses tealight glow beautifully. Can batch 4 per plate.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Funny Can Koozie | Puffer Jacket Style Can Cooler
products.creator: animuL67
products.makerworld_model: Igloo Cooler Koozie – 3D Printed Can Holder (base/no-logo)
products.recommended_filament: Silk PLA (metallic/shiny finish for the novelty look); PLA+ for durability
products.p1s_notes: Novelty igloo-cooler aesthetic scaled to hold a standard 12oz can. Funny gift item. Silk PLA in silver or gold looks especially premium. Sports team logo variants available as separate models in animuL67's library for team-branded upsell.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Geometric Table Lamp | Modern Home Decor Accent Lamp
products.creator: HpInvent
products.dimensions_mm: Base: 20–80mm height (5 options); Shade: 60–160mm height (6 options)
products.recommended_filament: Translucent or white PLA for diffused glow; dual-color for pattern contrast
products.p1s_notes: 3 pattern types: Lamp Shade Points, Geometric, Stars. Mix base and shade heights for custom proportions. Designed for BambuLab LED Lamp Kit-001. AMS multi-color highly recommended for pattern visibility.
products.hardware_required: BambuLab LED Lamp Kit-001 or compatible LED puck (~60mm diameter)

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Table Centerpiece | Boho Dining Table Decor | Arch Decor
products.creator: HpInvent
products.makerworld_model: Striaris — Capturing the pulse of linear grace
products.model_id_note: 4-piece fluted decor ensemble: tall ribbed vase, lidded jar, candle holder, round tray. 585 bookmarks, 162 likes, 204 downloads.
products.dimensions_mm: Multi-piece set — tall vase ~120mm, lidded jar ~80mm, tray ~200mm diameter
products.recommended_filament: Matte PLA in terracotta, clay, or warm neutral tones; Silk PLA for premium sheen
products.p1s_notes: Vertical fluting on all 4 pieces creates cohesive visual set. Print all 4 pieces for a complete centerpiece listing photo. Terracotta or warm clay matte PLA matches the styling in the hero photo. Strong upsell: sell as a set or offer individual pieces.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Tea Light Candle Holder Set | Boho Candleholder
products.creator: HpInvent
products.recommended_filament: Translucent PLA or white silk PLA; matte PLA for solid color geo look
products.p1s_notes: 4 distinct geo designs in the collection — print one of each for a varied set listing. Pairs with the Inflated Cloth tealight holder for a mixed boho candle bundle listing.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Mesh Table Lamp with Shade | Geometric Bedside Lamp
products.creator: HpInvent
products.recommended_filament: White or cream PLA for warm diffused glow; dual-color for quilted texture contrast
products.p1s_notes: Quilted fabric-like surface with warm LED glow. Designed for BambuLab LED Lamp Kit-001 or compatible 60mm puck. AMS two-color print (white body + accent color texture) creates stunning visual. Photography: backlight the lamp for hero shot.
products.hardware_required: BambuLab LED Lamp Kit-001 or ~60mm LED puck

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Coffee Bar Sign | Funny Cat Kitchen Decor
products.creator: tpubcom
products.makerworld_model: Crazy Cat Coffee Sign — Ready To Brew
products.recommended_filament: White or cream PLA for the sign face (crazy cat illustration reads best on light background)
products.p1s_notes: Flat sign — print face-down for smoothest front surface. White or cream PLA makes the crazy cat illustration pop. Part of tpubcom's cat design series (other cat variants available). Sells well as a gift, coffee bar decor, and kitchen humor niche.

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Ribbed Vase for Dried Flowers | Matte Black Boho Vase
products.creator: HpInvent
products.makerworld_model: Modern ribbed plant pot Vase — 2 sizes
products.recommended_filament: Matte black PLA for boho look; Silk PLA for premium sheen; PETG for water use
products.p1s_notes: Print in vase mode if model supports it for fastest print and best outer wall quality. Matte black PLA is the top-selling color for boho vases on Etsy. Offer both sizes in listing photos for upsell. Also available as geo ribbed variant (model 427984).

products.etsy_title: 3D Printed Crystal Glow Lamp | Faceted Geometric Table Lamp
products.creator: HpInvent
products.makerworld_model: Crystal Wireless Lamp — RGB Magical Crystals
products.recommended_filament: Translucent PLA (clear, smoke, or frosted) for crystal light diffusion; white PLA as base
products.p1s_notes: Designed for Bambu wireless RGB puck light — crystals sit over the puck and diffuse the colorful glow. Translucent PLA is essential for the light effect. AMS multi-color (mix clear + light blue + light purple) for a natural crystal look. Dark photo background makes the glowing crystals pop.
products.hardware_required: Bambu wireless RGB puck light (or compatible 60–70mm RGB LED puck)

filament_priorities: Silk PLA — primary upsell filament for koozies, vases, desk organizers
Translucent PLA — required for all lamp shades and crystal lamp
PETG — planters that will hold real soil/water
Matte PLA — vases, signs, boho decor
batch_printing: Koozies: 4x standard or 6x skinny per plate
led_hardware_required: BambuLab LED Lamp Kit-001 — for Geometric Lamp and Glowver Lamp
Bambu wireless RGB puck — for Crystal Glow Lamp
Battery LED tealights — for both candle holder sets
